cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiJack® Wall Spacer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01).

s: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Wall Spacer is an accessory to create a gap between raised pavers and the surrounding parapet wall. Wall spacers are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a compressible buffer to accommodate the expansion and contraction of materials under thermal influence.
SikaRoof® VersiJack® Wall Spacer is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Wall spacer for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

cl.x: Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.

cl.x: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Wall Spacer shall be installed with SikaRoof® VersiJack®. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Wall Spacer shall be placed on top of SikaRoof® VersiJack® before placing stone, concrete or porcelain pavers abut to the wall spacer for all pavers along the perimeter of the raised flooring installation.
